outcome: Utilization of long-acting reversible contraception (subdermal implant or intrauterine device)
Performance of permanent surgical sterilization (bilateral tubal ligation or bilateral salpingectomy)
cohort: Pregnant patients with and without malignancy who had vaginal and cesarean deliveries in a hospital setting in the USA from January 2017 to December 2020
finding: The preferred contraceptive option or method of sterilization at the time of hospital delivery differed by malignancy type among pregnant patients.
